name: Astralis A/S
summary: Astralis A/S operates as an esports company. It owns three esports teams under the Astralis, Origen, and Future FC brands. The company was formerly known as Astralis Group A/S and changed its name to Astralis A/S in April 2021. Astralis A/S was founded in 2016 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
